definitions.gloss: promotion to the next grade; advancing a level
definitions.explanation: Moving up to the next grade in school, or advancing to a higher rank or level in a system such as martial arts or swimming classes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進級|しんきゅう}⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was able to advance to the next grade without any problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{進級|しんきゅう}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If your grades are bad, you may not be able to advance to the next grade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進級|しんきゅう}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}して→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: My son was very happy after passing the swimming level-up test.

notes:
USAGE:
{進級|しんきゅう} is commonly used for school grade advancement and for progressing through ranked levels in activities like martial arts, swimming, or other structured programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進級|しんきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to advance to the next grade)
- {進級|しんきゅう}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (level-up test)
- {進級|しんきゅう}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (promotion examination)

RELATED WORDS:
Compare with ⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧ (advancing to a higher school, such as from middle school to high school), which refers to moving between schools rather than between grades within the same school. Also compare with ⟦{留年|りゅうねん}→留年：05141_ryuunen⟧ (repeating a year/being held back), the opposite outcome.
